title: Academy of Management Pulls 13,500-Person Conference Out of the U.S.
summary: Seattle’s loss is Vienna’s gain. The Academy of Management's decision to move its annual meeting out of the U.S. highlights how immigration policy and politics are shaping international meeting decisions.

title: Latest Exhibition Industry Forecast: Partly Cloudy
summary: The negative impact of the Iran war and Trump Administration policies is being felt across the exhibition industry — often negating any gains.

title: 25 Must-Know Meeting Planning Terms
summary: CSM, CVB, DMC. Beginner planners face an alphabet soup of acronyms. These 25 terms will get you off to a strong start — and there are hundreds more where they came from.

title: Apollo to Merge Emerald and Questex in $1.5 Billion Deal
summary: By combining Emerald and Questex, the private equity firm will create a company with more than 160 events across North America. The deal underscores growing confidence in live events, but Apollo will need to prove that bigger truly means better for exhibitors and attendees.

title: Conventions Help Drive San Francisco’s Tourism Recovery
summary: Mega-events like the Super Bowl and FIFA World Cup may grab headlines, but San Francisco’s convention business is becoming the real engine behind the city’s tourism recovery.

title: 5 Things You Should Know About Medical Meetings
summary: Compliance issues and transparency demands make medical and pharma meetings among the most complicated and challenging types of events to plan.

title: The Key Events Industry Statistics That Matter
summary: Data, facts, and figures from across the industry reflect a challenging landscape for 2026 — with some bright spots.

title: Disconnect to Connect: The Rise of Phone-Free Events
summary: Scrolling, texting, checking email. Attendees may be physically present at events but are often mentally elsewhere. Some planners think phone-free events may be the only way to get their attention back.

title: Women’s Conferences Just Keep Evolving
summary: Olympic athletes and former U.S. presidents on stage. Private invites to an AI discussion at Gloria Steinem's brownstone. Intimate opportunities to meet investors. These women's conferences keep raising the bar.

title: Spirit’s Shutdown Is One More Cost Squeeze on Events
summary: Airlines are replacing Spirit's routes, but not its ultra-low-cost fares. For planners already navigating rising costs, the timing couldn’t be worse.
